consumer: The engine's interactive pickup menu / inventory_selector input loop, asking which items the player selects to pick up from the tile's pile
scope: The interactive selection over the tile's ground-item stack driven through the real active input loop (menu query answered, items chosen), not a flat read of map::i_at
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (items) — iterates points_in_radius and dumps every map::i_at() item flatly into snapshot JSON with no selection/answer mechanism, exposing raw stack state rather than driving the pickup menu
divergence: A tile whose pile the pickup menu collapses/stacks or pages (e.g. several identical items shown as one selectable stack, or per-item charge-count sub-prompts): the raw export lists each item individually with no way to choose, so it cannot answer 'which items did the player pick' the way the menu would
